source.notes: Frozen reviewed Narrative Craft evaluation data. Each assigned check has 100 hits and 100 no-hits; mixed collections contain 25 passages per independent three-check combination. Review records and detector predictions are separate.

instructions: Development writing; freeze the balanced reviewed collection before prompt tuning.
